image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) standing on dirt and twigs. The bird is in profile facing left. It displays characteristic breeding male plumage: a black head with grey speckling on the crown/nape, a bright orange-rufous breast and belly, and black upperparts with distinct white shoulder patches and wing bars. A second, out-of-focus bird is visible in the background. The lighting is natural daylight.
